title: Husband’s home valuation rejected in Tennessee divorce appeal
summary_full: In a contentious marital dispute, a Tennessee appeals court confirmed the trial court's assessment of a marital home valued at $160,400, awarding the wife 75% of the home's equity—approximately $47,139. The husband's higher valuation based on comparable sales was dismissed by the court. Moreover, the court invalidated the husband's artwork and tool valuations, mandating their reassessment. It also made essential amendments to the permanent parenting plan concerning visitation rights.
